title: setup hook --scope user then --remove gives the user's original bytes back, and removes the file and folder jitso created
source: intended: docs/decisions.md v0.2 row (setup hook --scope user, plan 2.4): the guard registered in ~/.claude/settings.json for the owner's own session, same rules as project scope
intent: INTENDED behavior (plan 2.4, same byte-exact rule as project scope). With a `~/.claude/settings.json` that has other settings and a hook of the user's own, `--scope user --yes` then `--scope user --remove --yes` leaves the original bytes. When the file did not exist, `--remove` deletes it and prunes `~/.claude` again. A backup of the changed file is kept under `~/.jitso/backups`.
